original_description: Use Uxia to plan AI-powered UX research and analyze test results. Build or revise user-test drafts and define tasks, audiences and survey questions. Explore existing findings, screenshots, transcripts, survey responses and benchmarks to understand usability issues and prioritize improvements. Requires a connected Uxia MCP server.
summary_ja: UX調査のテスト案を作成し、結果や画面画像、回答などを調べて改善点を整理する。
limitations: Uxia MCPサーバーの接続が必要と表示。実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
